title: The Chamber of Reversed Sequence

features.name: consequence pool
features.desc-on-touch: You watch ripples expand backward through time. The effect sits here first, waiting. Causes have not yet arrived to claim them.

features.name: arrival memory
features.desc-on-touch: Objects drift in temporal suspension: a fallen photocopy, a broken probe, an unread letter. They are already here, but the moments that made them have not yet happened.

features.name: causal loop threshold
features.desc-on-touch: A marker where the archive's own timestamps reverse. Before this point, effects precede causes. After, time tries to remember how to flow forward again.

features.name: future echo chamber
features.desc-on-touch: Sound made this morning echoes from tomorrow. The archive is learning to store time itself, to hold moments at distance from their own occurrence.

features.name: paradox recorder
features.desc-on-touch: A diagnostic terminal playing back events: you see them resolve into causes that have not yet acted. The corruption loves this—it is all comparison, effect meeting its own becoming.

inscription: here consequences wait, preparing their own arrival as causes
